records.name: Body and Heart
records.objectives_text: Use the Cenarion Moondust on the Moonkin Stone of Auberdine to bring forth Lunaclaw. From there, you must face Lunaclaw and earn the strength of body and heart it possesses. Speak with Mathrengyl Bearwalker in Darnassus when you are done.

objectives.text: Face Lunaclaw and earn the strength of body and heart it possesses.

records.name: Body and Heart
records.objectives_text: Use the Cenarion Lunardust on the Moonkin Stone between Mulgore and the Barrens to bring forth Lunaclaw. From there, you must face Lunaclaw and earn the strength of body and heart it possesses. Speak with Turak Runetotem in Thunder Bluff when you are done.

objectives.text: Face Lunaclaw and earn the strength of body and heart it possesses.

records.name: Unfinished Business
records.objectives_text: Kill 2 Scarlet Medics, 2 Scarlet Hunters, 2 Scarlet Magi and 2 Scarlet Knights before returning to Kirsta Deepshadow in Western Plaguelands.

records.name: Zaeldarr the Outcast
records.objectives_text: Bring Zaeldarr's Head to Caretaker Alen at Light's Hope Chapel.

records.name: To Kill With Purpose
records.objectives_text: Travel to Corin's Crossing to the east and slaughter the Scourge that inhabit the town. Collect 7 pieces of Living Rot in under 10 minutes. Use the :Mortar and Pestle to grind the Living Rot into :Coagulated Rot.

records.name: Unfinished Business
records.objectives_text: Kill Huntsman Radley and Cavalier Durgen before returning to Kirsta Deepshadow in Western Plaguelands.

records.name: Hameya's Plea
records.objectives_text: Kill Infiltrator Hameya. Use his key on the Mound of Dirt behind the Undercroft.

records.name: Unfinished Business
records.objectives_text: Enter Hearthglen and find a high vantage point from which you can see the town and gauge the Scarlet Crusade's forces, then return to Kirsta Deepshadow in Western Plaguelands.

objectives.text: Overlook Hearthglen from a high vantage point

records.name: That's Asking A Lot
records.objectives_text: You will have to find a blacksmith and an engineer for these items.

records.name: Book of the Ancients
records.objectives_text: Get the Book of the Ancients and return it to Azore Aldamort at the tower in Ethel Rethor.

records.name: The Everlook Report
records.objectives_text: Deliver the Everlook Report to Argent Officer Pureheart at Chillwind Camp, Western Plaguelands.

records.name: The Everlook Report
records.objectives_text: Deliver the Everlook Report to Argent Officer Garush at the Bulwark, Western Plaguelands.

records.name: Duke Nicholas Zverenhoff
records.objectives_text: Deliver the book, "Studies in Spirit Speaking", to Duke Nicholas Zverenhoff at Light's Hope Chapel, Eastern Plaguelands.

records.name: Runecloth
records.objectives_text: Bring 30 Runecloth to Meilosh in Timbermaw Hold.

records.name: Sacred Cloth
records.objectives_text: Bring 2 Mooncloth to Meilosh in Timbermaw Hold.

records.name: Un-Life's Little Annoyances
records.objectives_text: Slay 20 Noxious Plaguebats and 10 Monstrous Plaguebats. Return to Nathanos Blightcaller when you are finished.

records.name: Taming the Beast
records.objectives_text: Use the Taming Rod to tame an Adult Plainstrider. Practice your skills, then return the Taming Rod to Yaw Sharpmane in Bloodhoof Village.

records.name: Taming the Beast
records.objectives_text: Use the Taming Rod to tame a Dire Mottled Boar. Practice your skills, then return the Taming Rod to Thotar in Razor Hill.

records.name: Taming the Beast
records.objectives_text: Use the Taming Rod to tame a Webwood Lurker. Practice your skills, then return the Taming Rod to Dazalar in Dolanaar.

records.name: Taming the Beast
records.objectives_text: Use the Taming Rod to tame a Large Crag Boar. Practice your skills, then return the Taming Rod to Grif Wildheart in Kharanos.

records.objectives_text: Speak with Yaw Sharpmane in Bloodhoof Village.

records.name: The Hunter's Path
records.objectives_text: Speak with Thotar at Razor Hill.

records.objectives_text: Speak with Dazalar in Dolanaar.

records.objectives_text: Speak with Grif Wildheart in Kharanos.

records.objectives_text: Speak with Ormak Grimshot in Orgrimmar.

records.name: Taming the Beast
records.objectives_text: Use the Taming Rod to tame an Armored Scorpid. Practice your skills, then return the Taming Rod to Thotar in Razor Hill.

records.name: Taming the Beast
records.objectives_text: Use the Taming Rod to tame a Surf Crawler. Practice your skills, then return the Taming Rod to Thotar in Razor Hill.

records.name: Taming the Beast
records.objectives_text: Use the Taming Rod to tame a Snow Leopard. Practice your skills, then return to Grif Wildheart in Kharanos.

records.name: Taming the Beast
records.objectives_text: Use the Taming Rod to tame an Ice Claw Bear. Practice your skills, then return the Taming Rod to Grif Wildheart in Kharanos.

records.name: Training the Beast
records.objectives_text: Speak with Belia Thundergranite in Ironforge.

records.name: Taming the Beast
records.objectives_text: Use the Taming Rod to tame a Prairie Stalker. Practice your skills, then return the Taming Rod to Yaw Sharpmane in Bloodhoof Village.

records.name: Taming the Beast
records.objectives_text: Use the Taming Rod to tame a Swoop. Practice your skills, then return the Taming Rod to Yaw Sharpmane in Bloodhoof Village.

records.name: Training the Beast
records.objectives_text: Speak with Holt Thunderhorn on Hunter Rise in Thunder Bluff.

records.name: Taming the Beast
records.objectives_text: Use the Taming Rod to tame a Nightsaber Stalker. Practice your skills, then return the Taming Rod to Dazalar in Dolanaar.

records.name: Taming the Beast
records.objectives_text: Use the Taming Rod to tame a Strigid Screecher. Practice your skills, then return the Taming Rod to Dazalar in Dolanaar.

records.name: Training the Beast
records.objectives_text: Speak to Jocaste in the Cenarion Enclave, in Darnassus.

records.name: Lessons Anew
records.objectives_text: Travel to Moonglade and speak with Dendrite Starblaze in the village of Nighthaven.

records.name: The Principal Source
records.objectives_text: Use the Empty Cliffspring Falls Sampler to draw a sample of water from the mouth of the cave by the falls. Deliver the Filled Cliffspring Falls Sampler to Alanndarian Nightsong in Auberdine, Darkshore.

records.name: Gathering the Cure
records.objectives_text: Bring 5 Earthroot and 12 Lunar Fungi to Alanndarian Nightsong in Auberdine so she may make a curative salve.

records.name: Curing the Sick
records.objectives_text: Use the Curative Animal Salve on 10 Sickly Deer that are located throughout Darkshore; doing so should cure them. Sickly Deer have been reported starting south of the Cliffspring River to the north of Auberdine and extending all the way into southern Darkshore where the edge of Ashenvale begins.

records.name: Power over Poison
records.objectives_text: Return to Mathrengyl Bearwalker in the Cenarion Enclave, Darnassus.

records.name: Lessons Anew
records.objectives_text: Travel to Moonglade and speak with Dendrite Starblaze in the village of Nighthaven.

records.name: The Principal Source
records.objectives_text: Use the Empty Dreadmist Peak Sampler to draw a sample of water from a pool at the top of the peak. Deliver the Filled Dreadmist Peak Sampler to Tonga Runetotem at the Crossroads, Barrens.

records.name: Gathering the Cure
records.objectives_text: Bring 5 Earthroot and 5 Kodo Horns to Tonga Runetotem at the Crossroads so he may make a curative salve.

records.name: Curing the Sick
records.objectives_text: Use the :Curative Animal Salve on 10 Sickly Gazelles that are located throughout the northern part of the Barrens; doing so should cure them. Sickly Gazelles have been reported north of the east-west road that runs through the Crossroads.

records.name: Power over Poison
records.objectives_text: Return to Turak Runetotem on the Elder Rise, Thunder Bluff.

records.name: Get Me Out of Here!
records.objectives_text: Escort Melizza Brimbuzzle, then speak with Hornizz Brimbuzzle at the Kodo Graveyard in Desolace.

records.name: The Ranger Lord's Behest
records.objectives_text: Travel to the northern borders of the Eastern Plaguelands and recover the :Quel'Thalas Registry. The item is somewhere in the Quel'Lithien lodge. You must also slay 8 Pathstriders, 8 Rangers, and 8 Woodsmen.

records.name: Ghost-o-plasm Round Up
records.objectives_text: Bring 8 Ghost-o-Plasms and the Crate of Ghost Magnets to Hornizz Brimbuzzle in Desolace.

records.name: Duskwing, Oh How I Hate Thee...
records.objectives_text: Find Duskwing and slay him. From the corpse, recover a Patch of Duskwing's Fur and return it to Nathanos Blightcaller. It is said that Duskwing roams the countryside to the north of Marris Stead.

prerequisites.wiki_text: To Kill With Purpose (Classic) , Un-Life's Little Annoyances , and The Ranger Lord's Behest

wiki.page: Duskwing, Oh How I Hate Thee... (Classic)

records.name: The Corpulent One
records.objectives_text: Find Borelgore in the northern wastes of Eastern Plaguelands and destroy him. Return to Nathanos Blightcaller when the mission is complete.

prerequisites.wiki_text: To Kill With Purpose (Classic) , Un-Life's Little Annoyances , and The Ranger Lord's Behest

records.name: Brother Anton
records.objectives_text: Speak with Brother Anton in Desolace.

records.name: Clam Bait
records.objectives_text: Find 10 pieces of Soft-shelled Clam Meat and bring it back to Mai'Lahii at Shadowprey Village.

records.name: Other Fish to Fry
records.objectives_text: Slay 7 Slitherblade Myrmidon, 7 Slitherblade Naga, and 5 Slitherblade Sorceresses, and then talk to Drulzegar at Shadowprey in Desolace.

records.name: The Call to Command
records.objectives_text: Travel to the Undercity and speak with Bragor Bloodfist.

prerequisites.wiki_text: Duskwing, Oh How I Hate Thee... (Classic) & The Corpulent One (Classic)

records.name: The Crimson Courier
records.objectives_text: Return to Eastern Plaguelands and track down the Crimson Courier. Kill the Courier and recover the Grand Crusader's Command. Take the command to Nathanos Blightcaller for further instruction.

records.name: Nathanos' Ruse
records.objectives_text: Travel to Tyr's Hand, southeast of the Marris Stead. Once there, take a bite of the Rotten Apple (old). While under the guise of the Scarlet Crusade, deliver The Grand Crusader's Command to Crusader Lord Valdelmar.

records.name: Return to Nathanos
records.objectives_text: Return to Nathanos Blightcaller with the new information.

records.name: The Scarlet Oracle, Demetria
records.objectives_text: The Scarlet Crusade is on the move. Somewhere along the road from Tyr's Hand to Stratholme you will find the Oracle, Demetria, and her entourage. Hunt her down and slay her. Return to Nathanos Blightcaller should you succeed.

records.name: Claim Rackmore's Treasure!
records.objectives_text: Find Rackmore's Silver Key. Find Rackmore's Golden Key. Find and open Rackmore's Chest.

records.name: A Husband's Last Battle
records.objectives_text: Kill Overlord Ror and return his claw to Dreka'Sur at Bloodvenom Post in Felwood.

records.name: Ramstein
records.objectives_text: Travel to Stratholme and slay Ramstein the Gorger. Take his head as a souvenir for Nathanos.

prerequisites.wiki_text: Duskwing, Oh How I Hate Thee... (Classic) & The Corpulent One (Classic)

records.name: Augustus' Receipt Book
records.objectives_text: Bring Augustus' Receipt Book to Augustus the Touched in Terrordale.

records.name: A Swift Message
records.objectives_text: Bring Lewis' Note to Thor the gryphon master.

records.name: The First and the Last
records.objectives_text: Speak with Mathias Shaw in Old Town Stormwind. He resides in the Barracks.

records.name: Honor the Dead
records.objectives_text: Speak with Mathias Shaw again if you wish to accept his task.

records.name: Flint Shadowmore
records.objectives_text: Travel to Chillwind Camp in the Western Plaguelands and meet up with your contact, Flint Shadowmore.

records.name: The Eastern Plagues
records.objectives_text: Scour the Eastern Plaguelands for clues as to the "Blightcaller" and the missing SI:7 agents. If you find any SI:7 Insignias, return them to Flint Shadowmore at Chillwind Camp.

records.name: The Blightcaller Cometh
records.objectives_text: Return to Stormwind and inform King Varian Wrynn of the fate of Nathanos Marris.

records.name: Order Must Be Restored
records.objectives_text: Assemble an army and travel to the Eastern Plaguelands. Launch a full assault on Nathanos Blightcaller and any Horde filth that may attempt to protect him. Keep your wits about you, . The Horde will defend the ranger lord with their very lives.

records.name: Dungar Longdrink
records.objectives_text: Bring Osric's Crate to Dungar Longdrink the gryphon master.

records.name: Continue to Stormwind
records.objectives_text: Buy a gryphon ride from the gryphon master Thor, then bring Lewis' Note to Osric Strang, in the shop Limited Immunity, in the Old Town of Stormwind.

records.name: Harpies Threaten
records.objectives_text: Maggran Earthbinder in Sun Rock Retreat wants you to slay 7 Bloodfury Harpies, 7 Bloodfury Ambushers, 7 Bloodfury Slayers and 7 Bloodfury Roguefeathers.

records.name: Bloodfury Bloodline
records.objectives_text: Maggran at Sun Rock Retreat wishes you to slay Bloodfury Ripper and bring her remains as proof of your deed.

records.name: Arachnophobia
records.objectives_text: Kill Besseleth and bring :Besseleth's Fang to Maggran at Sun Rock Retreat.

records.name: Return to Lewis
records.objectives_text: Buy a gryphon ride to Sentinel Hill from the gryphon master Dungar Longdrink, then take Osric's Crate to Lewis at Sentinel Hill.

records.name: Cycle of Rebirth
records.objectives_text: Tammra Windfield at Sun Rock Retreat wants you to gather 10 Gaea Seeds.

records.name: Supplying the Sepulcher
records.objectives_text: Bring :Podrig's Order to Karos Razok.

records.name: Michael Garrett
records.objectives_text: Bring Gordon's Crate to Michael Garrett.

records.name: Ride to the Undercity
records.objectives_text: Buy a bat ride to the Undercity from the bat master Karos Razok, then take Podrig's Order to Gordon Wendham in the Undercity.

records.name: Return to Morris
records.objectives_text: Buy a bat ride to Brill from the bat master Michael Garrett, then bring Gordon's Crate to Deathguard Morris in Brill.

records.name: The Bounty of Teldrassil
records.objectives_text: Bring Nessa's Collection to Vesprystus.

records.name: Flight to Auberdine
records.objectives_text: Ride a hippogryph to Auberdine from the hippogryph master Vesprystus, then bring Nessa's Collection to Laird.

records.name: Return to Nessa
records.objectives_text: Bring Laird's Response to Nessa Shadowsong.

records.name: Nessa Shadowsong
records.objectives_text: Speak with Nessa Shadowsong.

records.name: A Bundle of Hides
records.objectives_text: Bring the Bundle of Hides to the wind rider master Devrak in the Crossroads.

records.name: Ride to Thunder Bluff
records.objectives_text: Buy a wind rider to Thunder Bluff from the wind rider master Devrak, then bring the Bundle of Hides to Ahanu in Thunder Bluff.

records.name: Tal the Wind Rider Master
records.objectives_text: Bring Ahanu's Leather Goods to Tal in Thunder Bluff.

records.name: Return to Jahan
records.objectives_text: Buy a wind rider to the Crossroads from the wind rider master Tal, then bring :Ahanu's Leather Goods to Jahan Hawkwing.

records.name: Meats to Orgrimmar
records.objectives_text: Bring Zargh's Meats to Devrak in the Crossroads.

records.name: New Life
records.objectives_text: Plant 10 Enchanted Gaea Seeds in Gaea Dirt Mounds, and then return the remaining Enchanted Gaea Seeds to Tammra at Sun Rock Retreat.

records.name: The Ashenvale Hunt
records.objectives_text: Speak with Senani Thunderheart at Splintertree Post, Ashenvale.

prerequisites.wiki_text: The Ashenvale Hunt (The Barrens) / The Ashenvale Hunt (Thunder Bluff) / The Ashenvale Hunt (Orgrimmar)

records.name: Ride to Orgrimmar
records.objectives_text: Buy a wind rider to Orgrimmar from the wind rider master Devrak, then bring Zargh's Meats to Gryshka in Orgrimmar.

records.name: Doras the Wind Rider Master
records.objectives_text: Bring Gryshka's Letter to Doras in Orgrimmar.

records.name: Return to the Crossroads.
records.objectives_text: Buy a wind rider to the Crossroads from the wind rider master Doras, then bring Gryshka's Letter to Zargh at the Crossroads.

records.name: Honor Students
records.objectives_text: Bring Brock's List to Thorgrum Borrelson in Thelsamar.

records.name: Gryth Thurden
records.objectives_text: Bring the Honorary Picks to Gryth Thurden in Ironforge.

records.name: A Plague Upon Thee
records.objectives_text: Release the Plagueland Termites in the Northridge Lumber Mill, then return with the Barrel of Plagueland Termites to Nathaniel Dumah at Chillwind Camp in Western Plaguelands.

records.name: A Plague Upon Thee
records.objectives_text: Release the :Plagueland Termites in the Northridge Lumber Mill, then return with the Barrel of Plagueland Termites to Mickey Levine at the Bulwark in Tirisfal Glades.

records.name: Ride to Ironforge
records.objectives_text: Buy a gryphon to Ironforge from the gryphon master Thorgrum Borrelson, then bring Brock's List to Golnir Bouldertoe in Ironforge.

records.name: Return to Brock
records.objectives_text: Buy a gryphon to Thelsamar from the gryphon master Gryth Thurden, then bring the Honorary Picks to Brock Stoneseeker in Thelsamar.

records.name: Elemental War
records.objectives_text: Bring 10 Incendrites to Tsunaman at Sun Rock Retreat.

records.name: Marla's Last Wish
records.objectives_text: Bring Samuel Fipps' Remains to Marla's Grave, then return to Novice Elreth.

records.name: When Smokey Sings, I Get Violent
records.objectives_text: Travel to Plaguewood, northwest of Light's Hope. Destroy 8 Scourge Structures by using Smokey's Special Compound at the Mark of Detonation planted inside each building. Smokey has had the Ziggurats and Slaughterhouses marked. Once you plant the bomb, leave the building and marvel at your handiwork. By the way, Smokey's Special Compound is rather... unstable.

wiki.page: When Smokey Sings, I Get Violent

records.name: Stormwind Rendezvous
records.objectives_text: Travel to Stormwind City and venture to the city gates. Speak with Squire Rowe so that he may let Marshal Windsor know that you have arrived.

records.name: The Great Masquerade
records.objectives_text: Follow Reginald Windsor through Stormwind. Protect him from harm!

records.name: Boulderslide Ravine
records.objectives_text: Explore deep into the cave at Boulderslide Ravine and bring back 10 Resonite Crystals for Mor'rogal at Sun Rock Retreat to investigate.

records.name: Satyr Horns
records.objectives_text: Collect 16 Satyr Horns for Pixel in Splintertree Post.

records.name: Blood Feeders
records.objectives_text: Xen'Zilla at Malaka'Jin needs you to kill 10 Deepmoss Creepers and 7 Deepmoss Venomspitters.

records.name: Troll Charm
records.objectives_text: Bring 8 Troll Charms to Mitsuwa at Hellscream's Watch.

records.name: Earthen Arise
records.objectives_text: Open the Resonite cask with the Enchanted Resonite Crystal, and then slay Goggeroc. Return to Mor'rogal with the news and Enchanted Resonite Crystal.

records.name: Freedom to Ruul
records.objectives_text: Escort Ruul, then speak with Yama Snowhoof in Splintertree Post.

records.name: The Dragon's Eye
records.objectives_text: You must search the world for a being capable of restoring the power to the Fragment of the Dragon's Eye. The only information you possess about such a being is that they exist.

records.name: Drakefire Amulet
records.objectives_text: You must retrieve the Blood of the Black Dragon Champion from General Drakkisath. Drakkisath can be found in his throne room behind the Halls of Ascension in Blackrock Spire.

objectives.text: Blood of the Black Dragon Champion

target.name: Blood of the Black Dragon Champion
target.page: Blood of the Black Dragon Champion

records.name: Ashenvale Outrunners
records.objectives_text: Kill 9 Ashenvale Outrunners.

records.name: An Unholy Alliance
records.objectives_text: Bring Ambassador Malcin's Head to Varimathras in the Undercity.

records.name: An Unholy Alliance
records.objectives_text: Take the Small Scroll to Varimathras in the Undercity.

records.name: Protect Kaya
records.objectives_text: Escort Kaya Flathoof to Camp Aparaje, and then return to Makaba Flathoof near the southeastern edge of Stonetalon.

records.name: Report to Kadrak
records.objectives_text: Report to Kadrak at the watch tower in northern Barrens.

records.name: Report to Kadrak
records.objectives_text: Report to Kadrak at the watch tower in northern Barrens.

records.name: The Warsong Reports
records.objectives_text: Take the :Bundle of Reports to the Warsong Scout, Warsong Runner, and Warsong Outrider. Bring back the updates they give you to Kadrak at the northern watch tower in the barrens.

records.name: Torek's Assault
records.objectives_text: Escort Torek on his attack against Silverwing Outpost and Duriel Moonfire, then report to Ertog Ragetusk at Splintertree Post.

objectives.text: Return to Ertog Ragetusk at Falfarren River in Ashenvale.

records.name: Avenge My Village
records.objectives_text: Kill 8 Grimtotem Ruffians and 6 Grimtotem Mercenaries, and then return to Makaba Flathoof near the southeastern edge of Stonetalon.

records.name: Blackfathom Villainy
records.objectives_text: Bring the head of Twilight Lord Kelris to Bashana Runetotem in Thunder Bluff.

records.name: Trouble in the Deeps
records.objectives_text: Speak to Je'neu Sancrea in Ashenvale.

records.name: The Essence of Aku'Mai
records.objectives_text: Bring 20 Sapphires of Aku'Mai to Je'neu Sancrea in Ashenvale.

records.name: Allegiance to the Old Gods
records.objectives_text: Bring the Damp Note to Je'neu Sancrea in Ashenvale.

records.name: Allegiance to the Old Gods
records.objectives_text: Kill Lorgus Jett in Blackfathom Deeps and then return to Je'neu Sancrea in Ashenvale.

records.name: What the Wind Carries
records.objectives_text: Listen to Thrall speak.

records.name: The Champion of the Horde
records.objectives_text: Seek out Rexxar. The Warchief has instructed you as to his whereabouts. Search the paths of Desolace, between the Stonetalon Mountains and Feralas. Seek out Rokaro at Shadowprey Village in Desolace.

records.name: Mistress of Deception
records.objectives_text: Deliver Rokaro's Letter to Myranda the Hag in the Western Plaguelands.

records.name: Oculus Illusions
records.objectives_text: Travel to Blackrock Spire and collect 20 Black Dragonspawn Eyes. Return to Myranda the Hag when the task is complete.

records.name: Emberstrife
records.objectives_text: Travel to the Wyrmbog in Dustwallow Marsh and seek out Emberstrife's Den. Once inside, wear the Amulet of Draconic Subversion and speak with Emberstrife.

records.name: Warsong Supplies
records.objectives_text: Collect the Warsong Supplies: Warsong Saw Blades, Logging Rope, Warsong Oil, and the Warsong Axe Shipment for Locke Okarr in Splintertree Post.

records.name: The Test of Skulls, Scryer
records.objectives_text: You must find the blue dragonflight drake champion, Scryer, and slay him. Pry his skull from his corpse and return it to Emberstrife. You know that Scryer can be found in Winterspring.

records.name: The Test of Skulls, Somnus
records.objectives_text: Destroy the drake champion of the Green Flight, Somnus. Take his skull and return it to Emberstrife.

records.name: The Test of Skulls, Chronalis
records.objectives_text: Guarding the Caverns of Time in the Tanaris Desert is Chronalis, child of Nozdormu. Destroy him and return his skull to Emberstrife.

records.name: The Test of Skulls, Axtroz
records.objectives_text: Travel to Grim Batol and track down Axtroz, drake champion of the Red Flight. Destroy him and take his skull. Return the skull to Emberstrife.

records.name: Ascension...
records.objectives_text: It would appear as if the charade is over. You know that the Amulet of Draconic Subversion that Myranda the Hag created for you will not function inside Blackrock Spire. Perhaps you should find Rokaro and explain your predicament. Show him the Dull Drakefire Amulet. Hopefully he will know what to do next.

records.name: Blood of the Black Dragon Champion
records.objectives_text: Travel to Blackrock Spire and slay General Drakkisath. Gather his blood and return it to Rokaro.

target.page: Blood of the Black Dragon Champion

records.name: Trouble in Winterspring!
records.objectives_text: Find Donova Snowden near the hot springs in .

records.name: Enraged Wildkin
records.objectives_text: Speak with Jaron Stoneshaper in Starfall Village.

records.name: A Strange One
records.objectives_text: Speak with Winna Hazzard in Felwood.

records.name: A Little Luck
records.objectives_text: Speak with Witch Doctor Mau'ari in Everlook.

records.name: Nat Pagle, Angler Extreme
records.objectives_text: Nat Pagle wants you to catch the following fish: Misty Reed Mahi Mahi from the Misty Reed Strand in the Swamp of Sorrows. A Sar'theris Striker from the Sar'theris Strand in Desolace. Feralas Ahi from the Verdantis River of Feralas. Savage Coast Blue Sailfin from the Savage Coast of Stranglethorn Vale. Return to Nat Pagle when you have reeled them all in!

records.name: You Too Good.
records.objectives_text: You think Lumak is trying to tell you that he can no longer help you improve your fishing skill. You may want to try to find his friend, Nat Pagle, a human fishing off one of the islands south of Theramore (at least that's what you think Lumak said).

records.name: I Got Nothin' Left!
records.objectives_text: Travel to Kalimdor, to the coastal city of Theramore. From there you must search for an island, south of the main town. Nat Pagle awaits your arrival!

records.name: Clamlette Surprise
records.objectives_text: Dirge Quikcleave wants you to get the following items: 10 Giant Eggs. You will find those on the Rocs wandering Tanaris or any other species of large bird. 10 pieces of Zesty Clam Meat. You can find those in clams, naturally! 20 pieces of Fine Aged Cheddar. Get thee to a cheesery! Gather all of the items and return to Dirge.

records.name: To Gadgetzan You Go!
records.objectives_text: Travel to Gadgetzan in the Tanaris desert and speak with Dirge Quikcleave about advancing your cooking career.

records.name: I Know A Guy...
records.objectives_text: Travel to Gadgetzan in the Tanaris desert and speak with Dirge Quikcleave about advancing your cooking career.

records.name: Triage
records.objectives_text: Save patients by using Triage Bandages to tend to their wounds. You must save 15 patients before 6 of them die from their injuries. Remember the order of triage! Critically Injured Soldiers die the fastest followed by Badly Injured Soldiers. Injured Soldiers take the longest to die and should be saved AFTER your Critically Injured and Badly Injured Soldiers have been triaged.

records.name: Horde Trauma
records.objectives_text: Travel to Hammerfall in the Arathi Highlands and speak with Doctor Gregory Victor about joining the ranks of Horde Trauma.

records.name: Triage
records.objectives_text: Save patients by using Triage Bandages to tend to their wounds. You must save 15 patients before 6 of them die from their injuries. Remember the order of triage! Critically Injured Soldiers die the fastest followed by Badly Injured Soldiers. Injured Soldiers take the longest to die and should be saved AFTER your Critically Injured and Badly Injured Soldiers have been triaged.

records.name: Alliance Trauma
records.objectives_text: Travel to Theramore in the Dustwallow Marsh and speak with Doctor Gustaf VanHowzen about joining the ranks of Alliance Trauma.

records.name: A Host of Evil
records.objectives_text: Kill 8 Razorfen Battleguard, 8 Razorfen Thornweavers, and 8 Death's Head Cultists and return to Myriam Moonsinger near the entrance to Razorfen Downs.

records.name: Test of Lore
records.objectives_text: Answer Braug Dimspirit's question successfully and then speak to him again. He will remain in Stonetalon Mountains when you are ready.

records.name: Test of Lore
records.objectives_text: Answer Parqual Fintallas' question successfully and then speak to him again. He will remain in the Undercity until you are ready.

records.name: Kill Grundig Darkcloud
records.objectives_text: Kill Grundig Darkcloud and 6 Grimtotem Brutes, and return to Makaba Flathoof near the southeastern edge of Stonetalon.

records.name: Vorsha the Lasher
records.objectives_text: Defeat Vorsha the Lasher.

objectives.text: Speak to the Warsong Runner in Zoram'gar Outpost.

records.name: Deeprun Rat Roundup
records.objectives_text: Capture 5 Deeprun Rats by using the Rat Catcher's Flute. Lead the rats back to Monty. Don't forget to turn in the flute when you're finished.

records.name: Me Brother, Nipsy
records.objectives_text: Take the Carton of Mystery Meat to Nipsy at the Stormwind Deeprun Tram Depot.

records.name: The Manor, Ravenholdt
records.objectives_text: Take the Seal of Ravenholdt to Fahrad at Ravenholdt Manor, hidden away in the hills of Hillsbrad. Your cunning will be tested along the way. Be prepared.

records.name: The New Frontier
records.objectives_text: Speak with Mathrengyl Bearwalker at the Cenarion Enclave of Darnassus.

records.name: Rabine Saturna
records.objectives_text: Speak with Rabine Saturna in the village of Nighthaven, Moonglade. Moonglade lies between Felwood and Winterspring, accessible through a path out of Timbermaw Hold.

records.name: Poisoned Water
records.objectives_text: Use the Aspect of Neptulon on poisoned elementals of Eastern Plaguelands. Bring 12 Discordant Bracers and the Aspect of Neptulon to Duke Hydraxis in Azshara.

records.name: Stormers and Rumblers
records.objectives_text: Kill 15 Dust Stormers and 15 Desert Rumblers and then return to Duke Hydraxis in Azshara.

records.name: Eye of the Emberseer
records.objectives_text: Bring the Eye of the Emberseer to Duke Hydraxis in Azshara.

records.name: The Molten Core
records.objectives_text: Kill 1 Fire Lord, 1 Molten Giant, 1 Ancient Core Hound and 1 Lava Surger, then return to Duke Hydraxis in Azshara.

records.name: Agent of Hydraxis
records.objectives_text: Earn an faction with the Hydraxian Waterlords, then talk to Duke Hydraxis in Azshara.

records.name: Hands of the Enemy
records.objectives_text: Bring the Hands of Lucifron, Sulfuron, Gehennas and Shazzrah to Duke Hydraxis in Azshara.

records.name: Umber, Archivist
records.objectives_text: Take the Encrusted Silithid Object to Umber - the Cenarion Circle's archivist - in the village of Nighthaven, Moonglade.

records.name: Uncovering Past Secrets
records.objectives_text: Speak with Rabine Saturna in the village of Nighthaven, Moonglade.

records.name: Amongst the Ruins
records.objectives_text: Bring the Fathom Core to Je'neu Sancrea at Zoram'gar Outpost, Ashenvale.

records.name: Baron Aquanis
records.objectives_text: Bring the Strange Water Globe to Je'neu Sancrea in Blackfathom Deeps.

records.name: Great-father Winter is Here!
records.objectives_text: Speak with Greatfather Winter; he is located near the Smokywood Pastures vendor area in Orgrimmar.

records.name: Treats for Great-father Winter
records.objectives_text: Bring 5 Gingerbread Cookies and an Ice Cold Milk to Greatfather Winter in Orgrimmar.

records.name: Stolen Winter Veil Treats
records.objectives_text: Locate the Smokywood Pastures investigator that has gone missing in the snowy regions of the Alterac Mountains.

records.name: The Reason for the Season
records.objectives_text: Speak with Sagorne Creststrider in the Valley of Wisdom of Orgrimmar about the Feast of Winter Veil.

records.name: The Glowing Shard
records.objectives_text: Travel to Ratchet to find someone that can tell you more about the glowing shard. Then, deliver the shard as you are directed.

objectives.text: Speak with someone in Ratchet about the Glowing Shard

records.name: You're a Mean One...
records.objectives_text: Locate and return the Stolen Treats to Kaymard Copperpinch in Orgrimmar. It was last thought to be in the possession of the Abominable Greench, found somewhere in the snowy regions of the .

records.name: A Smokywood Pastures' Thank You!
records.objectives_text: Speak with Great-father Winter in Orgrimmar.
